existing_ABC.reason: A/B/C downstream utilities have already been observed.

if_later_gap_is_qualified.preferred_evidence: new predetermined frozen RNG realizations, not additional selection from A/B/C
before_generation_freeze: source-group/slot panel and class counts; no output-based slot replacement
exact checkpoint and normal hashes, prompt/bbox/mask/crop/scheduler/runtime
sample seed list plus derivation rule, number k and output count including all planned attempts
metric definitions/domains, handling of zero energy, missingness and numerical invalidity
ROI LPIPS implementation, padding/resize/version/weight identity and blinded semantic review where needed
paired slot analysis, class-wise summaries, uncertainty method and distinct condition-adherence/diversity endpoints
if_later_gap_is_qualified.paired_RNG_scope: Same slot across RNG; generator may consume RNG in VAE posterior samples AND initial noise. Eta=0 does not eliminate slot RNG variation.
if_later_gap_is_qualified.raw_output_retention: Every planned successful raw output enters all defined summaries; unavailable metrics are recorded, not used to drop images. Structural execution failures halt the comparison rather than reroll.
limitations: new RNG realizations can confirm fresh pixel measurement premises, not retroactively make downstream-exposed metric design independent
no defect validity follows from energy/diversity; semantics needs separate evidence
within-slot RNG samples and pairwise distances are dependent; do not treat all pairs as new independent slots
geometry crop clipping and weak-box error must be recorded before outputs, not tuned on AP
